title: Richard the conqueror, third brother, came after William the conquered
html_source:
This is a twist on the story earlier in the chapter of Richard Burbage going to meet a woman only to find William Shakespeare had met her first.

Here, Stephen posits that Richard Shakespeare, the youngest of the three adult brothers Shakespeare “conquered” his older brother William by having an affair with Anne Hathaway.

Stephen also plays with the word conquer, as the first Norman King of England, William I is usually referred to as William the Conqueror.
